alex: Hey team — CI linkcheck is failing on the 2.0 migration branch. Error shows a bunch of broken anchors for pages with Windows-style paths: `docs\guides\fast-start.md#install`

alex: Example from the job log:
```
> Broken link: /docs/guides/fast-start.md#install - referenced from /getting-started/overview.md
> Resolved path: docs\\guides\\fast-start.md -> normalized to docs/guides/fast-start.md#install
> Anchor not found: install
```

alex: Not sure if this is a MkDocs anchor-normalization issue or our preprocessor that normalizes paths. Filing here before I open a PR. @sara any quick ideas? :thinking_face:

sara: Ugh, saw something similar when I migrated a sidebar. Most common culprit is backslash -> slash normalization happening in one step but anchor generation (slugger) running on the raw filename elsewhere.

sara: If the file has a Windows path in the frontmatter `source_path: "docs\\guides\\fast-start.md"` it can confuse the doc generator. Can you grep for `source_path` or other custom fields?

michael: Also check for unusual heading characters. Our slugger strips punctuation; if your heading is `Installation & setup` the generated anchor becomes `installation--setup` and might not match `install` referenced elsewhere.

alex: Good point. In this case the target page has the heading `Install` so anchor should be `install` — but the resolver printed the normalized path with backslashes. I suspect the prebuild step that converts links isn't normalizing slashes early enough.

jen: If it's a link rewriting step, quick workaround is forcing POSIX paths in the link references: `[/guides/fast-start.md#install](/docs/guides/fast-start.md#install)` instead of `\` variants. But we should fix generator to tolerate either.

alex: I'm going to run a search/replace to convert `\\` to `/` in the docs content and in frontmatter `source_path` fields and run the linkcheck job locally. Will push a tiny PR if it fixes it.

docs-bot: linkcheck job queued for branch `2.0-migration` by alex — build #3421.

alex: Pushed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/1589 — includes a small script `tools/normalize_paths.py` and a couple of patched frontmatter files.

sara: Nice. Can you add a unit test for path normalization? A couple lines asserting `normalize("docs\\guides\\x.md") == "docs/guides/x.md"` will catch regressions.

alex: Yep adding test now. Also updated the anchor reference in `getting-started/overview.md` to match the actual slug `install` rather than `installation`.

docs-bot: linkcheck build #3421 passed on `2.0-migration` (checks: linkcheck, lint). :white_check_mark:

michael: Great. Follow-up: open a tiny issue to track making the resolver path-normalization idempotent cross-platform, so we don't keep sweeping this under PRs.

jen: Agreed. Filed https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/issues/402 — title: "Docs: unify path normalization for link rewriting (win/linux)".

alex: Thanks all. Closing this thread. If anyone sees similar flaky link errors, ping me and I'll share the script. :v:
